chunks: As for what has been reported regarding the criticism of the narrators of the Waqifiya, it is more than can be counted,
and it is present in the books of our scholars; we mention a portion of it.

key_terms.الوَاقِفَةِ: The Waqifiya, a Shia sect that stopped at a specific Imam

ai.seo_question: What is the source and volume of reports criticizing the Waqifiya sect in Shia hadith literature?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Tusi highlights the abundance of critical reports on the Waqifiya's narrators, emphasizing that this criticism is a established consensus within Shia scholarly tradition rather than an isolated view. By noting that the full corpus is too vast to enumerate, he underscores the severity of the doctrinal deviations attributed to this sect, particularly regarding their stance on the Imam's death. This introduction serves to validate the subsequent selection of hadiths as representative of a broader, well-documented scholarly consensus.
